evidence_items.explanation: Investors did punish Microsoft sharply over the cost of its AI build-out, which fits part of the forecast. But it was not part of a bubble collapse, so it does not resolve the claim.

receipt.public_excerpt: Despite the massive spending, by October 2026 the demand for AI computing power was exceeding supply, leading to a "gold rush" mentality and increasing prices for capacity.

evidence_items.explanation: Indicates that by October 2026 the AI bubble had not collapsed. The predicted collapse, which the claim requires, had not happened.

unresolved_gaps: No recognized collapse of the AI bubble had occurred by the evaluation date.
There were sell-offs in October 2026 (notably in China, Korea's KOSPI earlier) but they were not established as a collapse of the US AI bubble.
